title: 第240章  在座的各位都是孬兵！我说的！
slug: 四次入伍我被军区拉进黑名单
content_zh:
刘畅三人被孤立在圈子外，没人搭理，没人对话，孤零零站在操场边角。
陈山看着扎堆密谋的众人，忍不住压低声音，满脸头疼：“这帮老油条，防我们跟防贼一样，就这么把咱们排挤出来了。”
赵汉也是一脸无奈，皱着眉说道：“这局面太难搞了，十七人抱团，战术配合齐全，还有个韩征，我们三个就算想帮忙都没机会。”
“等下真打起来，我们要么硬着头皮对着连长开火，要么明目张胆放水，太明显了，一眼就能被看出来。”
陈山连连点头，苦着脸叹气：“对啊，这也太难了！放水放得太假，事后所有人都会举报我们徇私，不放水实打实打，连长绝对吃亏，这根本就是两难的死局！”
两人越说越着急，眼看距离对抗开始只剩不久了，半点办法都没有。
一旁的刘畅却始终神色沉稳，静静看着扎堆谋划战术的一众骨干，眼底毫无慌乱。
见两人心态越来越急，刘畅转头看向他们，语气严肃低沉：“难？那你们俩就眼睁睁看着咱们连长吃大亏、丢位置、被这帮人看不起？”
陈山和赵汉立刻沉默，狠狠摇头，眼神无比坚定。
不可能！
他们跟着林毅从抗洪硬仗里拼出来，亲眼见过他的担当和实力，绝对不可能看着他被这群心存偏见的老兵联手打压、当众落败。
刘畅看着两人的模样，缓缓开口，语气笃定：“既然不想看着连长吃亏，就别慌，别硬放水，也别实打实出力，我已经想好路子了。”
“稳住心态，等下对抗开始，一切按照我的计划来，既能帮连长牵制对手、里应外合，又不会被人抓到把柄，让人挑不出半点毛病。”
陈山、赵汉眼前一亮，连忙点头，悬着的心稍稍落地。
三人迅速靠拢，压低声音，开始细化属于他们的隐秘配合方案，静待这场离谱的二十一打二实战对抗开启。
连长办公室内。
林毅早已换好了全套荒漠迷彩作训服，穿戴规整，护具齐全。
他单手提着对抗步枪，枪身稳稳贴在身侧，身姿挺拔如松，静静立在落地窗前。
视线透过玻璃窗，清晰俯瞰着整片新兵连营区。
楼下，二十一名带兵骨干早已四散开来，有人扎堆蹲在操场角落嘀咕战术，有人分散到宿舍楼、训练场、器材室各个点位探查地形。

这些带兵骨干一个个穿戴护具、手持枪械，看似分工明确、严阵以待，实则各怀心思，乱糟糟一片。
身后，传来一阵轻微的脚步声。
石守疆一脸凝重地走到窗边，顺着林毅的目光看向楼下，眉头始终紧锁，压着声音带着担忧开口：“连长，说实话，你真确定这一局能稳得住？”
好歹也是二十一名带兵骨干，还是各连队的精锐，就算有三个自己人在内，又能起什么作用呢？
他一开始就觉得，这个办法好是好，只要能赢，这帮人以后绝对会对林毅服服帖帖，彻底信服。
但要是输了，代价可就太大了。
林毅头都没回，视线依旧落在楼下散落的人群身上，语气松弛淡然：“怎么？石副连长这是怀疑我会输啊？”
石守疆也不藏着掖着，性格直来直去，坦然点头：“嗯，这帮人不是刚入营的新兵蛋子，全是各个主战连队精挑细选出来的老兵骨干、带班班长、现役排长。”
“个个常年泡在训练场，大小实战对抗、战术演习参加过无数次，搜点、卡点、包抄、配合，经验老道得很。”
“二十一打二，人数差距太悬殊，风险太大了。”
代价也太大了！
这句话他没说，但他知道，林毅肯定心里清楚这一点。
林毅转过身，脸上没有半点紧张，反而嘴角挂着笑，“正因为他们是老兵、参加过无数次实战演习，我才特意选这种方式立规矩。”
“常规体能考核、队列训练，他们个个资历老、底子厚，只会觉得我是刻意刁难、仗权压人，心里永远不会服软，只会背地里更加抵触。”
“唯有实打实的战术对抗、硬实力碾压，才能一举打碎他们的傲气，让他们从心底认我这个连长。”
石守疆喉结滚动，脸色越发凝重，还是没忍住的问道：“可一旦败了呢？你之前当着所有人立下赌约，输了可是要主动调离新兵连的！”
赌约太重，几乎赌上了林毅在基层的所有口碑和仕途，换谁都不敢轻易冒险。
林毅闻言哈哈一笑，语气洒脱，半点不在意：“输了我就走人呗，多大点事。”
“当兵的，靠实力说话，输了就是输了，技不如人我认栽，没什么丢人的，但要是赢了，往后新兵连风气彻底理顺，这帮刺头骨干再也不敢私下非议、抱团闹事。”
说实话，他还真没想过输了会怎么样，输了的理由是随口想的，觉得这个理由听上去挺吸引人的。

当然，最主要的原因是，他压根不可能输。
并不是说看不起这帮带兵骨干，这些带兵骨干都很优秀，在各个连队里都是连长的心尖尖，但在他这，真不够看的。
他只能说，这些带兵骨干，都是一群孬兵，熊兵。
content_en:
The three of them, Liu Chang and Liu Chang, were isolated outside the circle. No one cared about them or talked to them. They stood alone in the corner of the playground.
Chen Shan looked at the people gathered together and conspired, and couldn't help lowering his voice, with a headache on his face: "These old fritters are guarding us as much as they are guarding thieves, and they just squeezed us out."
Zhao Han also looked helpless, frowning and said: "This situation is too difficult to handle. Seventeen people are in a group, the tactics are fully coordinated, and there is Han Zheng. Even if the three of us want to help, we have no chance."
"When a fight actually breaks out, we will either have to bite the bullet and open fire on the company commander, or we can blatantly let go. It's so obvious that it can be seen at a glance."
Chen Shan nodded repeatedly and sighed with a grimace: "Yes, this is too difficult! Let's go too far and everyone will report us for favoritism afterwards. If we don't let go, the company commander will definitely suffer. This is a dead end!"
The more they talked, the more anxious they became. Seeing that it was only a short time before the confrontation started, there was no way they could do anything.
Liu Chang on the side always had a calm expression, quietly looking at the group of backbones who were gathering together to plan tactics, without any panic in his eyes.
Seeing that the two people were getting more and more anxious, Liu Chang turned to look at them and said in a serious and low tone: "Is it difficult? Then you two just watch our company commander suffer a big loss, lose his position, and be looked down upon by these people?"
Chen Shan and Zhao Han immediately fell silent, shaking their heads fiercely, their eyes extremely firm.
impossible!
They followed Lin Yi through the tough battle against floods and saw his responsibility and strength with their own eyes. It was absolutely impossible for them to watch him be suppressed and defeated in public by this group of prejudiced veterans.
Liu Chang looked at the appearance of the two people and spoke slowly, with a firm tone: "Since you don't want to see the company commander suffer, don't panic, don't give in, and don't make real efforts. I have already thought of a way."
"Stabilize your mind and wait until the confrontation begins. Everything will go according to my plan. This will not only help the company commander contain the opponent and coordinate internally and externally, but will also prevent others from being caught and make it impossible for anyone to find fault."
Chen Shan and Zhao Han's eyes lit up and they nodded quickly, their hearts falling a little.
The three people quickly moved closer, lowered their voices, and began to detail their secret cooperation plan, waiting for this outrageous twenty-one versus two actual combat confrontation to begin.
In the company commander's office.
Lin Yi has already changed into a full set of desert camouflage training uniforms, neatly dressed and complete with protective gear.
He was holding a confrontation rifle in one hand, with the gun body firmly pressed against his side. His posture was as tall as a pine tree, and he stood quietly in front of the floor-to-ceiling window.
Through the glass window, he clearly overlooked the entire recruit company camp area.
Downstairs, the twenty-one leading troops had already dispersed. Some were squatting in the corner of the playground muttering about tactics, while others were scattered to various points in the dormitory building, training ground, and equipment room to explore the terrain.
Each of these backbone soldiers wore protective gear and held firearms. They seemed to have a clear division of labor and were ready for battle, but in fact they had their own agendas and were in a mess.
Behind him, there was a sound of slight footsteps.
Shi Shoujiang walked to the window with a solemn expression, followed Ji Yi's gaze downstairs, his brows furrowed all the time, and spoke with worry in his voice: "Company Commander, to be honest, are you really sure that this game can be stabilized?"
After all, they are still twenty-one leading troops, and they are still the elite of each company. Even if there are three of them, what role can they play?
He felt from the beginning that this method was good. As long as they could win, these people would definitely be obedient and completely convinced of Lin Yi in the future.
But if you lose, the price will be too high.
Lin Yi didn't even look back, his eyes still fell on the crowd scattered downstairs, and his tone was relaxed and indifferent: "What? Does Deputy Company Commander Shi doubt that I will lose?"
Shi Shoujiang didn't hide anything. He had a straightforward personality and nodded calmly: "Well, these people are not new recruits who have just joined the camp. They are all carefully selected veteran backbones, squad leaders, and active platoon leaders from each main battle company."
"Everyone has been at the training ground all year round, and has participated in countless actual combat confrontations and tactical exercises.Time, search points, stuck points, outflank, cooperate, very experienced and experienced. "
“Twenty-one against two, the difference in numbers is too huge and the risk is too great. "
The price is too high!
He didn't say this, but he knew that Ji Yi must know this in his heart.
Ji Yi turned around, there was no trace of nervousness on his face, but a smile on his face, "It is precisely because they are veterans and have participated in countless actual combat exercises that I deliberately chose this method to establish rules. "
"Routine physical fitness assessment and team training, all of them have senior qualifications and solid foundation. They will only think that I am deliberately making things difficult and using power to oppress others. They will never surrender in their hearts and will only become more resistant behind my back. "
“Only through real tactical confrontation and hard power crushing can we shatter their arrogance in one fell swoop and make them recognize me as the company commander from the bottom of their hearts. "
Shi Shoujiang's Adam's apple rolled, his face became more solemn, and he still couldn't help asking: "But what if we lose? You made a bet before in front of everyone. If you lose, you will be transferred from the recruit company! "
The bet was too heavy, almost all of Ji Yi's reputation and career at the grassroots level were on the line, and no one would dare to take the risk easily.
Ji Yi laughed when he heard this, his tone was free and easy, and he didn't care at all: "If I lose, I will leave. What a big deal. "
"As a soldier, strength speaks for itself. If you lose, you lose. If you are not as skilled as others, I will admit defeat. There is nothing to be ashamed of. But if you win, the atmosphere of the recruit company will be completely straightened out in the future. This group of hard-nosed backbones will no longer dare to criticize privately or make trouble together. "
To be honest, he never thought about what would happen if he lost. The reason for losing was just a random thought, and he thought this reason sounded quite attractive.
Of course, the main reason is that there is no way he can lose.
It's not that he looks down on these backbones of soldiers. These backbones of soldiers are all excellent and are the company commander's favorites in each company. But in his case, they are really not enough.
All he could say was that these leading troops were all a bunch of cowards and bear soldiers.
